item.title: Virginia | Geography, Capital, Map, History, & Facts | Britannica
item.description: Virginia is a constituent state of the U.S. and one of the original 13 colonies. It is bordered by Maryland to the northeast, the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast, North Carolina and Tennessee to the south, Kentucky to the west, and West Virginia to the northwest. The state capital is Richmond.
